data.long_meaning: Rakhshinda is a beautiful Urdu name for girls. The name Rakhshinda is derived from the Arabic word 'Rakhs' which means 'protector' and 'Shinda' which means 'life'. The name Rakhshinda signifies the protector of life. The name Rakhshinda carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu. Parents who choose Rakhshinda usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
